# Frontend QA Suite Full Guide

Use this guide for choosing and implementing effective test coverage.

## Scope

- Unit/component/integration/E2E strategy
- Deterministic assertions and stable fixtures
- Regression prevention and CI reliability

## Core Playbook

1. Map behavior change to test layer.
2. Build deterministic test scenarios.
3. Prevent flaky timing and shared state.
4. Verify coverage of critical edge cases.
